answer: Admission starts on an isolated island watch: a new key locks 1.91 POA for eleven epochs and hangs a 21-byte glass plate whose grain is hashed to the bond. Over 40 hours the watch must catch four tide pulses, at least 7 hours apart; each pulse is answered with a signed sighting that a public mirror board later republishes. Three unclustered keepers recompute the sighting chain from the live tip. A missed pulse burns 0.067 POA. Two plates that share a grain, or nine hangings from one wallet in 80 minutes, slash 49 percent of linked bonds and bar that island desk for seven epochs.
